text.en:
Section 10 of P.D. No. 694, as amended, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 10. Board of Directors Composition Per Diems Tenure. The affairs and business of the Bank shall be
directed and its property managed and preserved, unless otherwise provided in this Decree, by a Board of
Directors consisting of eleven members duly elected as hereinafter provided for a term of one year or after
their successors are duly elected and qualified, and who shall be paid a per diem of two hundred fifty pesos for
each meeting of the Board of Directors."
